B.learned: What REDPEN learned about on-device reading here When the cloud check found Gemini Nano misreading an answer, REDPEN kept it. From now on, an offline reading that matches one of these is held as “Check this” instead of counting, so you see the shaky marks before you are back online. REDPEN never changes what the device read, so it cannot push an answer towards the key. Device read “raned” → it was “runned” (short) Device read “A” → it was “D” (objective) Forget these
